start.title: The Crowd Follows
start.text:
Thousands have climbed the hill.
They hunger for his every word.

choices.feedback: Matthew 14:14 records that when Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them and healed their sick.

send_away.title: He Will Not Turn Them Away
send_away.text:
His eyes hold the whole crowd.
None will leave empty.

rest_consequence.title: Mercy First
rest_consequence.text:
Their hunger is his concern.
Stand ready beside him.

compassion.title: Evening Falls
compassion.text:
"They have nothing to eat."
The disciples murmur in fear.

choices.feedback: John 6:5-6 states that Jesus asked Philip where they could buy bread for the people to eat, testing him, for Jesus already knew what he was going to do.

count_consequence.title: Not by Silver
count_consequence.text:
Two hundred coins would not be enough.
Look with new eyes.

boy.title: A Small Offering
boy.text:
A boy lifts a humble basket.
Five loaves. Two small fish.

choices.feedback: John 6:9 mentions Andrew telling Jesus about a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish.

dismiss_consequence.title: Little Is Much
dismiss_consequence.text:
In his hands, little is plenty.
Receive the boy's gift.

mock_consequence.title: Honor the Gift
mock_consequence.text:
His brave little heart deserves more.
Carry his basket gently.

bless.title: He Lifts His Eyes
bless.text:
He raises the bread to heaven.
A hush falls on the hillside.

choices.feedback: Matthew 14:19, Mark 6:41, Luke 9:16, and John 6:11 all record that Jesus looked up to heaven and gave thanks/blessed the food.

unbelief_consequence.title: Stay and See
unbelief_consequence.text:
The miracle begins in his hands.
Do not miss it.

distribute.title: Pass It On
distribute.text:
He breaks. He gives. He breaks again.
The baskets do not empty.

choices.text: Serve the crowd row by row
choices.feedback: Matthew 14:19, Mark 6:41, Luke 9:16, and John 6:11 all state that Jesus broke the loaves and gave them to the disciples to distribute to the crowd.

hide_consequence.title: Trust the Giver
hide_consequence.text:
There is plenty for every mouth.
Keep no portion back.

choices.text: Serve the crowd row by row

feast.title: All Are Filled
feast.text:
Families eat together on green grass.
No one rises hungry.

choices.feedback: John 6:12 records that after everyone had eaten, Jesus told his disciples to gather the pieces that were left over.

waste_consequence.title: Gather It All
waste_consequence.text:
Every fragment is mercy made bread.
Let nothing be lost.

baskets.title: Twelve Baskets Full
baskets.text:
From a boy's gift, abundance overflows.
With little, he gives much.
